name: minibase
description: Ultra-lightweight, zero-config, open-source Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) with embedded SQLite

scripts.build:exe: caxa --input . --output minibase.exe --exclude minibase_data minibase_test_data .git examples tmp_seed -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/bin/minibase.js" serve --open
scripts.build:linux: caxa --input . --output minibase-linux --exclude minibase_data minibase_test_data .git examples tmp_seed -- "{{caxa}}/node_modules/.bin/node" "{{caxa}}/bin/minibase.js" serve
